title: MiniGIM Lijst — bindings of checklist items to data services
description: Maps every Omgevingsanalyse Lijst item to a delivery route: auto (deterministic fetch+derivation from a keyless open service), partial (fetched proxy or partial coverage, explicitly labelled), manual (documented human pointer) or out-of-scope (group/structural row). Registry completeness is enforced by test: every lijst item must have exactly one binding.

status.description: auto: runner levert laag+statistiek uit sleutelloze open bron; partial: runner levert expliciet gelabelde proxy/dekking; manual: gedocumenteerde menselijke route; out-of-scope: structurele rij (groepskop).

serviceRefs.description: ids into poc-minigim/data/sources.json; empty for derived/input items.

proxyNote.description: verplichte labeling bij status=partial: wat is de proxy/dekking en waarom.

manualPointer.description: url of route voor status=manual: waar haalt een mens dit op.
